1. Position at the end of the bar in between your feet
2. Squat to depth 
3. Squeeze glutes up tall 
4. Small hands? Use attachment

title: Brace Squat
trainerCues:
1. Press the weight to full extension before squatting 
2. Squat to good depth
benefits: Teaches proper squat form by forcing core firing from anterior load

title: Alternating Kettlebell Overhead Press
trainerCues:
1. Engage lats 
2. Knuckles turn forward at top of movement 
3. Always return to racked position, controlling weight down

title: Supine Ant-rotation Press

title: Contralateral Single Leg Deadlift
trainerCues:
1. Load is in opposite hand from working leg 
2. Lower the weight slowly while keeping a neutral spine 
3. Return to the top with controlled hip drive
benefits: Hip dominant strength, single leg stability

3. Lower the weight back to the shoulder under control
